items.title: Two explosions reported at an air defense site in Bandar Lengeh after the Sirik strike; Trump says big strikes “could happen, very soon.”
No Iranian crude loadings since Aug 25 (Kpler); Tehran planning a 2027 budget with zero oil revenue.
CFO Colette Kress running Nvidia on an interim basis; shares fell nearly 7% on Huang's exit (The Information).
Shooter identified as ER physician Matt Lambert; reports tie it to a condo dispute.
Daily Mail: Blanche moved to a military base after death threats; WH reportedly weighing Lutnick's future.
Kushner says a prisoner-of-war exchange has been finalized.
IRNA says an “enemy” strike hit Sirik near the Strait; reports blaming US airstrikes aren't confirmed.
Reuters: Huang also had a relationship with a second employee; Nvidia's probe continues.
Global Outlook, Teams and 365 outage peaked near 130,000 Downdetector reports.
US Army lieutenant colonel arrested in a UK sting over alleged secrets for Russia (WSJ).
Trump told Hugh Hewitt he'd consider military action against Cuba.
Jensen Huang resigned from all Nvidia posts; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO.
Five people shot at a gym near Logan Circle; suspect in custody.
Impeachment push blocked on a procedural vote with 11 Democrats absent.
Crew abandoned the VLCC Dominica Prosperity after a projectile hit off Ras al Khaimah (UKMTO).
Zelensky says Starshield links are capped at 100 mph along the front.
Assembly of Experts calls an NPT withdrawal review an “unavoidable necessity”; no notice given.
USS George H.W. Bush families told to plan for deployments of up to 12 months.
Rep. Garcia names Wiles, Noem, Guilfoyle and Lewandowski among planned probes.
